selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and distinguish it from similar apparel like aprons or towels.
To verify the legibility and structural correctness of the embroidered text, a common failure point in AI generation.
To ensure the ties are physically connected to the bib body and the edges are sharp without melting into the background.
To analyze the consistency of the terry cloth vs. woven textures and check for subtle blending artifacts.

focus_areas: Text rendering quality (spelling and font structure)
Texture distinction between terry cloth and smooth fabric sections
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the embroidery of 'LUCIA'. AI often struggles with simulating realistic cross-stitch or embroidery textures, often resulting in blurry or floating letters. Verify if the green letters appear physically stitched into the fabric mesh. Also, check the shadow cast by the ties to ensure they lie naturally on the surface.
